mismatches: The upright pillar is oriented vertically (parallel to Z-axis) instead of being tilted at 30 degrees as specified in R3 and the design document.
The mounting face normal is (0, 0, 1) or similar vertical orientation rather than (0, cos30, sin30).
The sensor screw holes are drilled vertically along the Z-axis instead of being perpendicular to a tilted mounting face.
systemic: The design document specifies a tilted upright pillar for a 30-degree mount, but the resulting geometry is a vertical block which fails to provide the required tilt for the sensor.
summary: The part is rendered as a standard vertical pillar with vertical holes, failing to implement the 30-degree tilt required by the design specifications.
